raw.description: 战斗阶段结束时记录对手当回合所使用技能的类型，若该类型与上次记录不同则100%令对手害怕3回合，若该类型与上次记录相同则对手该类型技能下回合先制-1|自身攻击技能命中后，若对手处于害怕状态则令对手害怕回合数-1并附加200点固定伤害，每生效1次增加100点，最多400点，自身属性技能命中后，若对手处于害怕状态则令对手害怕回合数+1并吸取对手最大体力的40%，每生效1次减少10%，最低20%|（boss无效）

review.reviewedBy: Codex exact primary source, real two-version selection and battle-state tests
review.rationale: 来源技能类型由SeerAPI skill_category/1物理、2特殊、4属性核实。实际用招记录与命中状态独立；两版保留原hash/计数封顶/吸取起终值，公共害怕时长操作不重新进行异常准入；全部当前双方，无队伍依赖。
review.singleBehavior: 战阶记录当前敌实际使用的物理/特殊/属性，首次/改变按公共3回合害怕，相同类型下回合仅该类先制-1；被控、药剂、行动前无PP不记录，MISS/无效但已用仍记录。命中害怕的攻击先缩短1后固定200递增100封顶400/500；属性先延长1后理论40到20或50到30百分比吸取，各自计数独立，免伤仍保留时长与理论回复。

success.name: 4894全部17招逐实例有序编译和64种子基础，两版真实魂印2081/2104原生逐招用招；魂印与同ID技能效果2081严格分域
success.assertion: test('4894全部17招逐实例有序编译和64种子基础，两版真实魂印2081/2104原生逐招用招；魂印与同ID技能效果2081严格分域',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2081,2104]){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[id].sourceHash,source.souls.find(x=>x.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(e=>[e.effectId,e.index,e.params]),c.operations.map(e=>[e.effectId,e.index,e.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4894 base '+m.id);}assert.notEqual(E.SOULS.registry[2081],E.WIKI.effectsEngine.registry[2081]);});

success.name: 4894两版真实魂印只记录对手实际用招类型，首次与变更害怕3回合，受控/药剂/零PP未用不记录，已用但MISS或整招无效仍记录
success.assertion: test('4894两版真实魂印只记录对手实际用招类型，首次与变更害怕3回合，受控/药剂/零PP未用不记录，已用但MISS或整招无效仍记录',()=>{for(const id of[2081,2104])for(const mode of['status','physical','special','control','potion','noPP','miss','invalid']){const s=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});let enemy=mode==='status'?20117:mode==='special'?10716:10127;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']=3;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'攻击必失');}if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,1,'skillBlock');const play=()=>turn(s,10250,mode==='potion'?null:enemy);if(mode==='noPP')observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.t.pp[key(enemy)]=0;},play);else play();const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894,recorded=!['control','potion','noPP'].includes(mode);assert.equal(st.records.length,recorded?1:0);if(recorded){assert.equal(st.records[0].kind,mode==='status'?'status':mode==='special'?'special':'physical');assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],3);}}});

success.name: 4894真实魂印相同类型下回合该类型先制负1，其他类型不受影响；改变类型施加害怕而不错误沿用新惩罚
success.assertion: test('4894真实魂印相同类型下回合该类型先制负1，其他类型不受影响；改变类型施加害怕而不错误沿用新惩罚',()=>{for(const next of[20117,10127]){const s=make({move:10250,soul:true});turn(s,10250,20117);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.clearAilments(c.t);},()=>turn(s,10250,20117));const penalty=s.fighters[1].effects['同类技能先制降低4894'];assert.equal(penalty.kind,'status');assert.equal(penalty.start,3);assert.equal(penalty.end,3);turn(s,10250,next);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,next===20117?-1:0);if(next===10127)assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']);}});

success.name: 4894真实2081/2104攻击命中害怕先减1回合再固定200/300递增封顶400或500，零红仍触发、无害怕不增加，计数独立于属性吸取
success.assertion: test('4894真实2081/2104攻击命中害怕先减1回合再固定200/300递增封顶400或500，零红仍触发、无害怕不增加，计数独立于属性吸取',()=>{for(const [id,max]of[[2081,400],[2104,500]]){const s=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});for(let n=0;n<5;n++){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[0].pp[key(10250)]=40;s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=s.round+8;const before=s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'];turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),Math.min(max,200+n*100));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],before-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,n+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,0);}const zero=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});zero.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(zero),0);assert.equal(sum(zero,'fixed'),200);const no=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});turn(no,10250,null);assert.equal(no.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,0);}});

success.name: 4894真实2081/2104属性命中害怕先延长1回合，百分比吸取40/30/20或50/40/30递减封底，理论回复不因免伤低HP减少且不受技能禁疗
success.assertion: test('4894真实2081/2104属性命中害怕先延长1回合，百分比吸取40/30/20或50/40/30递减封底，理论回复不因免伤低HP减少且不受技能禁疗',()=>{for(const[id,start,min]of[[2081,40,20],[2104,50,30]]){const s=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');for(let n=0;n<4;n++){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[0].hp=1000;s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=s.round+4;const before=s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'];turn(s,20270,null);const amount=9000*Math.max(min,start-10*n)/100;assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),amount);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],before+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,n+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,0);}const immune=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(immune,1,'固定百分比免疫');immune.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;turn(immune,20270,null);assert.equal(sum(immune,'percent'),0);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].hp,1000+9000*start/100);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,1);}});

success.name: 4894真实魂印害怕最后1回合被缩短则走公共移除链；MISS/无效/控制不消耗计数，害怕回合增减本身不重新触发异常准入和反弹
success.assertion: test('4894真实魂印害怕最后1回合被缩短则走公共移除链；MISS/无效/控制不消耗计数，害怕回合增减本身不重新触发异常准入和反弹',()=>{for(const mode of['hit','miss','invalid','control']){const s=make({move:10250,soul:true});s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=1;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,0,'攻击必失');}if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹']=3;turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,mode==='hit'?1:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],undefined);}const s=make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;s.fighters[1].counts.immune=2;timer(s,1,'reflect');turn(s,20270,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],4);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕'],undefined);});

success.name: 4894真实两版属性技能自身同招先害怕后魂印立即延长与吸取；免异阻止同招害怕则魂印不增加属性计数
success.assertion: test('4894真实两版属性技能自身同招先害怕后魂印立即延长与吸取；免异阻止同招害怕则魂印不增加属性计数',()=>{for(const id of[2081,2104])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:29321,index:2,soul:true,hp:1000});if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,29321,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,immune?0:1);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:id===2081?3600:4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,immune?1000:id===2081?4600:5500);}});

success.name: 4894真实两版魂印固定免疫仍缩短害怕并按生效次数递增；属性吸取目标保1和低HP均保留理论回复与完整百分比记录
success.assertion: test('4894真实两版魂印固定免疫仍缩短害怕并按生效次数递增；属性吸取目标保1和低HP均保留理论回复与完整百分比记录',()=>{for(const id of[2081,2104]){const s=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=5;timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,1);delete s.fighters[1].effects['固定百分比免疫'];turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),300);for(const floor of[false,true]){const a=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1});a.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;if(floor)timer(a,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(a,20270,20117);const amount=id===2081?3600:4500;assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);const e=a.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,amount);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,floor?0:1);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,floor?1:0);}}});

boundary.name: 4894两版真实魂印只记录对手实际用招类型，首次与变更害怕3回合，受控/药剂/零PP未用不记录，已用但MISS或整招无效仍记录

interaction.name: 4894真实两版属性技能自身同招先害怕后魂印立即延长与吸取；免异阻止同招害怕则魂印不增加属性计数
interaction.assertion: test('4894真实两版属性技能自身同招先害怕后魂印立即延长与吸取；免异阻止同招害怕则魂印不增加属性计数',()=>{for(const id of[2081,2104])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:29321,index:2,soul:true,hp:1000});if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,29321,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,immune?0:1);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:id===2081?3600:4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,immune?1000:id===2081?4600:5500);}});

interaction.name: 4894真实两版魂印固定免疫仍缩短害怕并按生效次数递增；属性吸取目标保1和低HP均保留理论回复与完整百分比记录
interaction.assertion: test('4894真实两版魂印固定免疫仍缩短害怕并按生效次数递增；属性吸取目标保1和低HP均保留理论回复与完整百分比记录',()=>{for(const id of[2081,2104]){const s=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=5;timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,1);delete s.fighters[1].effects['固定百分比免疫'];turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),300);for(const floor of[false,true]){const a=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1});a.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;if(floor)timer(a,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(a,20270,20117);const amount=id===2081?3600:4500;assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);const e=a.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,amount);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,floor?0:1);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,floor?1:0);}}});

raw.description: 战斗阶段结束时记录对手当回合所使用技能的类型，若该类型与上次记录不同则100%令对手害怕3回合，若该类型与上次记录相同则对手该类型技能下回合先制-1|自身攻击技能命中后，若对手处于害怕状态则令对手害怕回合数-1并附加200点固定伤害，每生效1次增加100点，最多500点，自身属性技能命中后，若对手处于害怕状态则令对手害怕回合数+1并吸取对手最大体力的50%，每生效1次减少10%，最低30%|（boss无效）

review.reviewedBy: Codex exact primary source, real two-version selection and battle-state tests
review.rationale: 来源技能类型由SeerAPI skill_category/1物理、2特殊、4属性核实。实际用招记录与命中状态独立；两版保留原hash/计数封顶/吸取起终值，公共害怕时长操作不重新进行异常准入；全部当前双方，无队伍依赖。
review.singleBehavior: 战阶记录当前敌实际使用的物理/特殊/属性，首次/改变按公共3回合害怕，相同类型下回合仅该类先制-1；被控、药剂、行动前无PP不记录，MISS/无效但已用仍记录。命中害怕的攻击先缩短1后固定200递增100封顶400/500；属性先延长1后理论40到20或50到30百分比吸取，各自计数独立，免伤仍保留时长与理论回复。

success.name: 4894全部17招逐实例有序编译和64种子基础，两版真实魂印2081/2104原生逐招用招；魂印与同ID技能效果2081严格分域
success.assertion: test('4894全部17招逐实例有序编译和64种子基础，两版真实魂印2081/2104原生逐招用招；魂印与同ID技能效果2081严格分域',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2081,2104]){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[id].sourceHash,source.souls.find(x=>x.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(e=>[e.effectId,e.index,e.params]),c.operations.map(e=>[e.effectId,e.index,e.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4894 base '+m.id);}assert.notEqual(E.SOULS.registry[2081],E.WIKI.effectsEngine.registry[2081]);});

success.name: 4894两版真实魂印只记录对手实际用招类型，首次与变更害怕3回合，受控/药剂/零PP未用不记录，已用但MISS或整招无效仍记录
success.assertion: test('4894两版真实魂印只记录对手实际用招类型，首次与变更害怕3回合，受控/药剂/零PP未用不记录，已用但MISS或整招无效仍记录',()=>{for(const id of[2081,2104])for(const mode of['status','physical','special','control','potion','noPP','miss','invalid']){const s=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});let enemy=mode==='status'?20117:mode==='special'?10716:10127;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']=3;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'攻击必失');}if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,1,'skillBlock');const play=()=>turn(s,10250,mode==='potion'?null:enemy);if(mode==='noPP')observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.t.pp[key(enemy)]=0;},play);else play();const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894,recorded=!['control','potion','noPP'].includes(mode);assert.equal(st.records.length,recorded?1:0);if(recorded){assert.equal(st.records[0].kind,mode==='status'?'status':mode==='special'?'special':'physical');assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],3);}}});

success.name: 4894真实魂印相同类型下回合该类型先制负1，其他类型不受影响；改变类型施加害怕而不错误沿用新惩罚
success.assertion: test('4894真实魂印相同类型下回合该类型先制负1，其他类型不受影响；改变类型施加害怕而不错误沿用新惩罚',()=>{for(const next of[20117,10127]){const s=make({move:10250,soul:true});turn(s,10250,20117);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.clearAilments(c.t);},()=>turn(s,10250,20117));const penalty=s.fighters[1].effects['同类技能先制降低4894'];assert.equal(penalty.kind,'status');assert.equal(penalty.start,3);assert.equal(penalty.end,3);turn(s,10250,next);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,next===20117?-1:0);if(next===10127)assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']);}});

success.name: 4894真实2081/2104攻击命中害怕先减1回合再固定200/300递增封顶400或500，零红仍触发、无害怕不增加，计数独立于属性吸取
success.assertion: test('4894真实2081/2104攻击命中害怕先减1回合再固定200/300递增封顶400或500，零红仍触发、无害怕不增加，计数独立于属性吸取',()=>{for(const [id,max]of[[2081,400],[2104,500]]){const s=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});for(let n=0;n<5;n++){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[0].pp[key(10250)]=40;s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=s.round+8;const before=s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'];turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),Math.min(max,200+n*100));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],before-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,n+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,0);}const zero=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});zero.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(zero),0);assert.equal(sum(zero,'fixed'),200);const no=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});turn(no,10250,null);assert.equal(no.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,0);}});

success.name: 4894真实2081/2104属性命中害怕先延长1回合，百分比吸取40/30/20或50/40/30递减封底，理论回复不因免伤低HP减少且不受技能禁疗
success.assertion: test('4894真实2081/2104属性命中害怕先延长1回合，百分比吸取40/30/20或50/40/30递减封底，理论回复不因免伤低HP减少且不受技能禁疗',()=>{for(const[id,start,min]of[[2081,40,20],[2104,50,30]]){const s=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');for(let n=0;n<4;n++){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[0].hp=1000;s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=s.round+4;const before=s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'];turn(s,20270,null);const amount=9000*Math.max(min,start-10*n)/100;assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),amount);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],before+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,n+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,0);}const immune=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(immune,1,'固定百分比免疫');immune.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;turn(immune,20270,null);assert.equal(sum(immune,'percent'),0);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].hp,1000+9000*start/100);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,1);}});

failure.name: 4894真实2081/2104属性命中害怕先延长1回合，百分比吸取40/30/20或50/40/30递减封底，理论回复不因免伤低HP减少且不受技能禁疗
failure.assertion: test('4894真实2081/2104属性命中害怕先延长1回合，百分比吸取40/30/20或50/40/30递减封底，理论回复不因免伤低HP减少且不受技能禁疗',()=>{for(const[id,start,min]of[[2081,40,20],[2104,50,30]]){const s=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');for(let n=0;n<4;n++){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[0].hp=1000;s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=s.round+4;const before=s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'];turn(s,20270,null);const amount=9000*Math.max(min,start-10*n)/100;assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),amount);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],before+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,n+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,0);}const immune=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(immune,1,'固定百分比免疫');immune.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;turn(immune,20270,null);assert.equal(sum(immune,'percent'),0);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].hp,1000+9000*start/100);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,1);}});

failure.name: 4894真实魂印害怕最后1回合被缩短则走公共移除链；MISS/无效/控制不消耗计数，害怕回合增减本身不重新触发异常准入和反弹
failure.assertion: test('4894真实魂印害怕最后1回合被缩短则走公共移除链；MISS/无效/控制不消耗计数，害怕回合增减本身不重新触发异常准入和反弹',()=>{for(const mode of['hit','miss','invalid','control']){const s=make({move:10250,soul:true});s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=1;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,0,'攻击必失');}if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹']=3;turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,mode==='hit'?1:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],undefined);}const s=make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;s.fighters[1].counts.immune=2;timer(s,1,'reflect');turn(s,20270,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],4);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕'],undefined);});

failure.name: 4894真实两版属性技能自身同招先害怕后魂印立即延长与吸取；免异阻止同招害怕则魂印不增加属性计数
failure.assertion: test('4894真实两版属性技能自身同招先害怕后魂印立即延长与吸取；免异阻止同招害怕则魂印不增加属性计数',()=>{for(const id of[2081,2104])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:29321,index:2,soul:true,hp:1000});if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,29321,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,immune?0:1);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:id===2081?3600:4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,immune?1000:id===2081?4600:5500);}});

failure.name: 4894真实两版魂印固定免疫仍缩短害怕并按生效次数递增；属性吸取目标保1和低HP均保留理论回复与完整百分比记录
failure.assertion: test('4894真实两版魂印固定免疫仍缩短害怕并按生效次数递增；属性吸取目标保1和低HP均保留理论回复与完整百分比记录',()=>{for(const id of[2081,2104]){const s=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=5;timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,1);delete s.fighters[1].effects['固定百分比免疫'];turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),300);for(const floor of[false,true]){const a=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1});a.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;if(floor)timer(a,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(a,20270,20117);const amount=id===2081?3600:4500;assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);const e=a.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,amount);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,floor?0:1);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,floor?1:0);}}});

boundary.name: 4894全部17招逐实例有序编译和64种子基础，两版真实魂印2081/2104原生逐招用招；魂印与同ID技能效果2081严格分域
boundary.assertion: test('4894全部17招逐实例有序编译和64种子基础，两版真实魂印2081/2104原生逐招用招；魂印与同ID技能效果2081严格分域',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2081,2104]){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[id].sourceHash,source.souls.find(x=>x.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(e=>[e.effectId,e.index,e.params]),c.operations.map(e=>[e.effectId,e.index,e.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4894 base '+m.id);}assert.notEqual(E.SOULS.registry[2081],E.WIKI.effectsEngine.registry[2081]);});

boundary.name: 4894两版真实魂印只记录对手实际用招类型，首次与变更害怕3回合，受控/药剂/零PP未用不记录，已用但MISS或整招无效仍记录
boundary.assertion: test('4894两版真实魂印只记录对手实际用招类型，首次与变更害怕3回合，受控/药剂/零PP未用不记录，已用但MISS或整招无效仍记录',()=>{for(const id of[2081,2104])for(const mode of['status','physical','special','control','potion','noPP','miss','invalid']){const s=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});let enemy=mode==='status'?20117:mode==='special'?10716:10127;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']=3;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'攻击必失');}if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,1,'skillBlock');const play=()=>turn(s,10250,mode==='potion'?null:enemy);if(mode==='noPP')observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.t.pp[key(enemy)]=0;},play);else play();const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894,recorded=!['control','potion','noPP'].includes(mode);assert.equal(st.records.length,recorded?1:0);if(recorded){assert.equal(st.records[0].kind,mode==='status'?'status':mode==='special'?'special':'physical');assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],3);}}});

interaction.assertion: test('4894真实2081/2104攻击命中害怕先减1回合再固定200/300递增封顶400或500，零红仍触发、无害怕不增加，计数独立于属性吸取',()=>{for(const [id,max]of[[2081,400],[2104,500]]){const s=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});for(let n=0;n<5;n++){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[0].pp[key(10250)]=40;s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=s.round+8;const before=s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'];turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),Math.min(max,200+n*100));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],before-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,n+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,0);}const zero=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});zero.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(zero),0);assert.equal(sum(zero,'fixed'),200);const no=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});turn(no,10250,null);assert.equal(no.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,0);}});

interaction.name: 4894真实2081/2104属性命中害怕先延长1回合，百分比吸取40/30/20或50/40/30递减封底，理论回复不因免伤低HP减少且不受技能禁疗
interaction.assertion: test('4894真实2081/2104属性命中害怕先延长1回合，百分比吸取40/30/20或50/40/30递减封底，理论回复不因免伤低HP减少且不受技能禁疗',()=>{for(const[id,start,min]of[[2081,40,20],[2104,50,30]]){const s=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');for(let n=0;n<4;n++){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[0].hp=1000;s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=s.round+4;const before=s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'];turn(s,20270,null);const amount=9000*Math.max(min,start-10*n)/100;assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),amount);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],before+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,n+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,0);}const immune=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(immune,1,'固定百分比免疫');immune.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;turn(immune,20270,null);assert.equal(sum(immune,'percent'),0);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].hp,1000+9000*start/100);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,1);}});

interaction.name: 4894真实魂印害怕最后1回合被缩短则走公共移除链；MISS/无效/控制不消耗计数，害怕回合增减本身不重新触发异常准入和反弹
interaction.assertion: test('4894真实魂印害怕最后1回合被缩短则走公共移除链；MISS/无效/控制不消耗计数，害怕回合增减本身不重新触发异常准入和反弹',()=>{for(const mode of['hit','miss','invalid','control']){const s=make({move:10250,soul:true});s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=1;if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,0,'攻击必失');}if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹']=3;turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,mode==='hit'?1:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],undefined);}const s=make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;s.fighters[1].counts.immune=2;timer(s,1,'reflect');turn(s,20270,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],4);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕'],undefined);});

interaction.name: 4894真实两版属性技能自身同招先害怕后魂印立即延长与吸取；免异阻止同招害怕则魂印不增加属性计数
interaction.assertion: test('4894真实两版属性技能自身同招先害怕后魂印立即延长与吸取；免异阻止同招害怕则魂印不增加属性计数',()=>{for(const id of[2081,2104])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:29321,index:2,soul:true,hp:1000});if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,29321,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,immune?0:1);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:id===2081?3600:4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,immune?1000:id===2081?4600:5500);}});

interaction.name: 4894真实两版魂印固定免疫仍缩短害怕并按生效次数递增；属性吸取目标保1和低HP均保留理论回复与完整百分比记录
interaction.assertion: test('4894真实两版魂印固定免疫仍缩短害怕并按生效次数递增；属性吸取目标保1和低HP均保留理论回复与完整百分比记录',()=>{for(const id of[2081,2104]){const s=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=5;timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,1);delete s.fighters[1].effects['固定百分比免疫'];turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),300);for(const floor of[false,true]){const a=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1});a.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;if(floor)timer(a,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(a,20270,20117);const amount=id===2081?3600:4500;assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);const e=a.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,amount);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,floor?0:1);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,floor?1:0);}}});

success.assertion: test('4894/1897清强成功授3回合整回合红输出预算300，固定伤害不共用，未有强两回回复减半，保护失败不授，两版本模板依据保留',()=>{const s=make({...row(1897),loadout:[38349,10250,20270,29323,38351],bStats:{atk:9999,spa:9999}});s.fighters[1].stages.atk=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['攻击输出上限'].perRoundAttackOutput,true);{const engine=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...engine,run(p,o,c){const out=engine.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&c.m.id===key(10716))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));return out;}};try{turn(s,10250,10716);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=engine;}}const hits=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===2&&e.sourceSide===1);assert.equal(hits.filter(e=>e.type==='attack').reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),300);assert.equal(hits.filter(e=>e.type==='fixed').reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),50);for(const mode of['none','protected']){const a=make(row(1897));if(mode==='protected'){a.fighters[1].stages.atk=1;timer(a,1,'强化保护');}turn(a,a.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].effects['回复效果削减'],mode==='none');assert.equal(a.fighters[1].effects['攻击输出上限'],undefined);}turn(s,10250,10716);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.round===3&&e.sourceSide===1&&e.type==='attack').reduce((n,e)=>n+e.settledDamage,0),300);const evidence=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4894/REUSED-1897-SEMANTICS.json');assert.deepEqual(evidence.currentMetadata,evidence.historicalMetadata);});

success.name: 4894/5速命中防特防真实重复实例与15%弱防成功失败、2敌低于半体才威力倍增；16睡眠30与15害怕20成功失败和免疫
success.assertion: test('4894/5速命中防特防真实重复实例与15%弱防成功失败、2敌低于半体才威力倍增；16睡眠30与15害怕20成功失败和免疫',()=>{for(const[id,values]of[[20270,{spe:-1}],[20816,{acc:-2}],[20679,{def:-1,spd:-1}]]){const s=make({move:id});turn(s,id,null);for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(values))assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[k],v);}for(const[id,name]of[[35160,'睡眠'],[14409,'害怕'],[13300,null]]){const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=24;seed++){const s=make({move:id,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s,id,null);seen.add(name?!!s.fighters[1].ailments[name]:s.fighters[1].stages.def<0);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);}const low=make({move:10396,targetHp:4499}),edge=make({move:10396,targetHp:4500});const a=probe(()=>turn(low,10396,20117)),b=probe(()=>turn(edge,10396,20117));assert.equal(a.power,2*b.power);});

success.name: 4894/191反弹回合不消费次数；1115净弱实际成功才敌下一次攻击无效，909仅先手害怕成功失败补300，后手不触发补偿

success.assertion: test('4894/1399清回合害怕成功不授次数免异，清失败或害怕免疫均授同源刷新一、异源保留；1048目标异常红增伤100%，2081无异常随机一PP归零不补抽',()=>{for(const mode of['success','protected','immune']){const s=make(row(1399));if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'protect');if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune??0,mode==='success'?0:1);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],mode==='success');}const a=make(row(1048)),b=make(row(1048));a.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;const am=probe(()=>turn(a)),bm=probe(()=>turn(b));assert.equal(am.modifier,bm.modifier*2);for(const abnormal of[false,true]){const s=make(row(2081));if(abnormal)s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].moves.filter(k=>s.fighters[1].pp[k]===0).length,abnormal?0:1);}const future=make({...row(698),targetHp:1});turn(future,future.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(future.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(future.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],undefined);});

success.name: 4894/1399同源次数免异刷新一、已有异源两次独立保留，后授来源先消费；清回合失败属于未触发补偿
success.assertion: test('4894/1399同源次数免异刷新一、已有异源两次独立保留，后授来源先消费；清回合失败属于未触发补偿',()=>{const s=make({move:38351,index:0});timer(s,1,'protect');s.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;turn(s,38351,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,3);turn(s,38351,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,3);const sources=s.fighters[0].soulState.ailmentImmuneSources;assert.equal(sources.at(-1).key,'1399:57f7210d:0:0');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,38351,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ailmentImmuneSources.some(e=>e.key==='1399:57f7210d:0:0'&&e.count>0),false);});

success.name: 4894全部17招逐实例有序编译和64种子基础，两版真实魂印2081/2104原生逐招用招；魂印与同ID技能效果2081严格分域
success.assertion: test('4894全部17招逐实例有序编译和64种子基础，两版真实魂印2081/2104原生逐招用招；魂印与同ID技能效果2081严格分域',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2081,2104]){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[id].sourceHash,source.souls.find(x=>x.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(e=>[e.effectId,e.index,e.params]),c.operations.map(e=>[e.effectId,e.index,e.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4894 base '+m.id);}assert.notEqual(E.SOULS.registry[2081],E.WIKI.effectsEngine.registry[2081]);});

success.name: 4894真实2081/2104攻击命中害怕先减1回合再固定200/300递增封顶400或500，零红仍触发、无害怕不增加，计数独立于属性吸取
success.assertion: test('4894真实2081/2104攻击命中害怕先减1回合再固定200/300递增封顶400或500，零红仍触发、无害怕不增加，计数独立于属性吸取',()=>{for(const [id,max]of[[2081,400],[2104,500]]){const s=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});for(let n=0;n<5;n++){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[0].pp[key(10250)]=40;s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=s.round+8;const before=s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'];turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),Math.min(max,200+n*100));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],before-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,n+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,0);}const zero=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});zero.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(zero),0);assert.equal(sum(zero,'fixed'),200);const no=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});turn(no,10250,null);assert.equal(no.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,0);}});

success.name: 4894真实2081/2104属性命中害怕先延长1回合，百分比吸取40/30/20或50/40/30递减封底，理论回复不因免伤低HP减少且不受技能禁疗
success.assertion: test('4894真实2081/2104属性命中害怕先延长1回合，百分比吸取40/30/20或50/40/30递减封底，理论回复不因免伤低HP减少且不受技能禁疗',()=>{for(const[id,start,min]of[[2081,40,20],[2104,50,30]]){const s=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');for(let n=0;n<4;n++){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[0].hp=1000;s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=s.round+4;const before=s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'];turn(s,20270,null);const amount=9000*Math.max(min,start-10*n)/100;assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),amount);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],before+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,n+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,0);}const immune=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(immune,1,'固定百分比免疫');immune.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;turn(immune,20270,null);assert.equal(sum(immune,'percent'),0);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].hp,1000+9000*start/100);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,1);}});

success.name: 4894/1399清回合害怕成功不授次数免异，清失败或害怕免疫均授同源刷新一、异源保留；1048目标异常红增伤100%，2081无异常随机一PP归零不补抽
success.assertion: test('4894/1399清回合害怕成功不授次数免异，清失败或害怕免疫均授同源刷新一、异源保留；1048目标异常红增伤100%，2081无异常随机一PP归零不补抽',()=>{for(const mode of['success','protected','immune']){const s=make(row(1399));if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'protect');if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune??0,mode==='success'?0:1);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],mode==='success');}const a=make(row(1048)),b=make(row(1048));a.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;const am=probe(()=>turn(a)),bm=probe(()=>turn(b));assert.equal(am.modifier,bm.modifier*2);for(const abnormal of[false,true]){const s=make(row(2081));if(abnormal)s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].moves.filter(k=>s.fighters[1].pp[k]===0).length,abnormal?0:1);}const future=make({...row(698),targetHp:1});turn(future,future.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(future.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(future.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],undefined);});

success.name: 4894/2081无异常随机PP抽样含零PP不补抽，PP减免阻挡；1380准备复活前态验证实际下一两回合先制负二及第三回到期
success.assertion: test('4894/2081无异常随机PP抽样含零PP不补抽，PP减免阻挡；1380准备复活前态验证实际下一两回合先制负二及第三回到期',()=>{const s=make({move:38351,index:2});for(const k of s.fighters[1].moves)s.fighters[1].pp[k]=0;turn(s,38351,null);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[1].pp[k]===0));const immune=make({move:38351,index:2}),old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,trait(f,k){return f.side===1&&k==='ppReductionImmune'?true:old.trait(f,k);}};try{turn(immune,38351,null);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}for(const k of immune.fighters[1].moves)assert.equal(immune.fighters[1].pp[k],immune.moveDefinitions[k].pp);const a=make({move:29322,loadout:[29322,10250,20270,29323,38351]});turn(a,29322,null);a.fighters[0].hp=9000;delete a.fighters[0].soulState.deathResolved;a.finished=false;a.winner=null;for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(a,10250,20117);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?-2:0);}});

interaction.assertion: test('4894全部17招逐实例有序编译和64种子基础，两版真实魂印2081/2104原生逐招用招；魂印与同ID技能效果2081严格分域',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2081,2104]){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[id].sourceHash,source.souls.find(x=>x.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(e=>[e.effectId,e.index,e.params]),c.operations.map(e=>[e.effectId,e.index,e.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4894 base '+m.id);}assert.notEqual(E.SOULS.registry[2081],E.WIKI.effectsEngine.registry[2081]);});

interaction.name: 4894真实2081/2104攻击命中害怕先减1回合再固定200/300递增封顶400或500，零红仍触发、无害怕不增加，计数独立于属性吸取
interaction.assertion: test('4894真实2081/2104攻击命中害怕先减1回合再固定200/300递增封顶400或500，零红仍触发、无害怕不增加，计数独立于属性吸取',()=>{for(const [id,max]of[[2081,400],[2104,500]]){const s=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});for(let n=0;n<5;n++){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[0].pp[key(10250)]=40;s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=s.round+8;const before=s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'];turn(s,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),Math.min(max,200+n*100));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],before-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,n+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,0);}const zero=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});zero.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero,10250,null);assert.equal(sum(zero),0);assert.equal(sum(zero,'fixed'),200);const no=V(id).make({move:10250,soul:true});turn(no,10250,null);assert.equal(no.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,0);}});

interaction.name: 4894真实2081/2104属性命中害怕先延长1回合，百分比吸取40/30/20或50/40/30递减封底，理论回复不因免伤低HP减少且不受技能禁疗
interaction.assertion: test('4894真实2081/2104属性命中害怕先延长1回合，百分比吸取40/30/20或50/40/30递减封底，理论回复不因免伤低HP减少且不受技能禁疗',()=>{for(const[id,start,min]of[[2081,40,20],[2104,50,30]]){const s=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');for(let n=0;n<4;n++){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[0].hp=1000;s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=s.round+4;const before=s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'];turn(s,20270,null);const amount=9000*Math.max(min,start-10*n)/100;assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),amount);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+amount);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],before+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,n+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.attackCount,0);}const immune=V(id).make({move:20270,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(immune,1,'固定百分比免疫');immune.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;turn(immune,20270,null);assert.equal(sum(immune,'percent'),0);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].hp,1000+9000*start/100);assert.equal(immune.fighters[0].soulState.ansel4894.statusCount,1);}});

interaction.name: 4894/1399清回合害怕成功不授次数免异，清失败或害怕免疫均授同源刷新一、异源保留；1048目标异常红增伤100%，2081无异常随机一PP归零不补抽
interaction.assertion: test('4894/1399清回合害怕成功不授次数免异，清失败或害怕免疫均授同源刷新一、异源保留；1048目标异常红增伤100%，2081无异常随机一PP归零不补抽',()=>{for(const mode of['success','protected','immune']){const s=make(row(1399));if(mode==='protected')timer(s,1,'protect');if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune??0,mode==='success'?0:1);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],mode==='success');}const a=make(row(1048)),b=make(row(1048));a.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;const am=probe(()=>turn(a)),bm=probe(()=>turn(b));assert.equal(am.modifier,bm.modifier*2);for(const abnormal of[false,true]){const s=make(row(2081));if(abnormal)s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].moves.filter(k=>s.fighters[1].pp[k]===0).length,abnormal?0:1);}const future=make({...row(698),targetHp:1});turn(future,future.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(future.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(future.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],undefined);});
